note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sent a 5-model Burna Boyz unit to a 'backfield gap' screen position far from any enemy and from the army. Round 1 offers no threat to screen against, so the move wastes the unit's turn. Fix: Scale screen_base by the enemy threat that the screen position blocks, such as enemy units that can reach the screened unit next turn or that could deep strike there. Give a screen with no threat a base near 0. Add a bonus for units that are useful elsewhere, such as Burna Boyz with a 12 in flamer for staying near home or the centre line.
